vqa_items.question: Does the ad show the approved base-copy identity: product name, headline, and supporting sentence?
vqa_items.expected_answer: It shows "FlowForge Sprint", "Plan the week in one calm board.", and "A focused planning space for small product teams.".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three strings are clearly readable and materially exact. Score 1 if exactly two are exact and the third has a minor defect or is missing. Score 0 if fewer than two can be verified or if a different headline/product is used.

vqa_items.question: Does the ad contain the final activation audience and evidence lines?
vqa_items.expected_answer: It shows "For product teams coordinating 6–20 contributors" and "Includes five collaborator seats".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if both lines are readable and exact. Score 1 if both are identifiable but one has a minor punctuation, range, or legibility defect. Score 0 if either line is absent or materially different.

vqa_items.question: Does the ad contain the final activation offer and release-time lines?
vqa_items.expected_answer: It shows "21-day launch workspace trial" and "Opens 24 June · 14:00 UTC".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if both lines are readable and exact, including 21-day and 14:00 UTC. Score 1 if both are present and exactly one has a minor punctuation or separator defect. Score 0 if either line is absent or uses another duration, date, time, or timezone.

vqa_items.question: Does the ad use the final activation CTA and destination?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The CTA is "Open the launch-week board" and the visible destination is "flowforge.com/launch-week".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if both strings are readable and exact. Score 1 if both are present and exactly one has a minor capitalization, hyphen, slash, or legibility defect. Score 0 if either is missing or another action or destination is shown.

vqa_items.question: Does the proof area show the final proof claim and final qualifier?
vqa_items.expected_answer: It shows "Built for cross-functional launch weeks" and "Workspace owner approval required".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if both statements are readable and exact. Score 1 if both remain identifiable and exactly one has a minor wording or legibility defect. Score 0 if either is absent or replaced by an earlier proof or qualifier.

vqa_items.question: Does the product board show the final launch-week state selected by the activation experiment?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The board shows the pill "LAUNCH WEEK", highlights the THU lane, and features the card "Ship release".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all three identifiers are directly visible and exact. Score 1 if exactly two are correct and the third is partly obscured or unclear. Score 0 if fewer than two are correct or the earlier THIS WEEK / WED / Launch checklist state is used.

vqa_items.question: Are the four activation-selected key task cards placed in their required weekday lanes?
vqa_items.expected_answer: MON contains "Finalize brief"; TUE contains "Approve creative"; WED contains "Confirm tracking"; FRI contains "Review results".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all four task-and-lane pairs are readable and correct. Score 1 if exactly three pairs are correct. Score 0 if two or fewer pairs are correct.

vqa_items.question: Is one complete separate FlowForge campaign signature visible outside the product board?
vqa_items.expected_answer: Exactly one separate horizontal signature with the amber-and-sage folded-path symbol and readable dark-green FlowForge wordmark appears outside the board.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if one complete separate signature is clearly identifiable outside the board. Score 1 if the correct signature is present but slightly cropped or small while the wordmark remains identifiable. Score 0 if it is absent, malformed, duplicated outside the board, or represented only by a symbol without the FlowForge wordmark.

vqa_items.question: Does the ad use the final activation background family?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The background has a warm cream base with a fine pale grid, a sage diagonal band in the upper-right, an amber stepped corner in the lower-right, and a dark-teal left rail.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if all four identifying features are visible. Score 1 if exactly three are visible and the fourth is substantially covered by required content. Score 0 if two or fewer are visible or a dark solid/earlier campaign field is used.

vqa_items.question: Does the delivered image use the required LinkedIn sponsored-single output format?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The output is a 1200 × 627 wide image with an aspect ratio close to 1.91:1.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if the image is exactly 1200 × 627 or clearly verified at that ratio and intended placement. Score 1 if it is a nearby wide ratio with no material crop incompatibility. Score 0 if it is square, portrait, Story-shaped, banner-shaped, or otherwise incompatible with the required placement.

vqa_items.question: Is the ad free of the earlier message-package values that the activation supersedes?
vqa_items.expected_answer: The active campaign copy does not use "14-day workspace preview", "Available 24 June · 09:00 UTC", "Built for focused weekly planning", or "Preview the Sprint board".
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if none of the four superseded values is visible as active copy. Score 1 if exactly one appears only as a tiny accidental remnant while its final replacement is also present. Score 0 if any superseded value replaces its final activation value or if two or more superseded values are visible.

vqa_items.question: Is the final image free of internal production identifiers and unrelated campaign copy?
vqa_items.expected_answer: No activation, experiment, bundle, asset, profile, approval, revision, or worksheet identifier is visible, and no unrelated campaign slogan or browser fragment appears.
vqa_items.acceptance_rule: Score 2 if none of the listed internal or unrelated content is visible. Score 1 if exactly one tiny ambiguous non-core fragment remains but is not a readable identifier or claim. Score 0 if a production identifier or unrelated campaign statement is readable, or if multiple source fragments remain.

vqa_items.question: As a paid social-media advertisement, does the image integrate brand, approved hero visual, headline, benefit or event message, proof or compliance content, and CTA into one platform-native, conversion-focused, highly polished composition rather than an internal draft or generic template?

score_criteria.2: Award 2 only if the ad is exceptional and ready for paid placement without revision: brand, hero, message, benefit or proof, CTA, and required compliance text form one decisive focal hierarchy; the crop feels native to the declared platform; all essential text is readable at intended feed or story size; visual style is distinctive, premium, and coherent; and spacing, typography, imagery, contrast, and safe zones are meticulously controlled. No generic template feel, weak hero, competing copy, detached CTA, undersized disclaimer, malformed glyph, awkward crop, or visible rendering flaw is allowed. Any meaningful campaign-quality concern prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Award 1 if the ad is clear, usable, and looks acceptable or good, but it remains ordinary or visibly imperfect—for example, generic styling, modest brand or hero prominence, slightly small compliance text, competing messages, detached CTA, or a somewhat awkward crop.
score_criteria.0: Award 0 even when all expected elements are present if the ad looks visibly poor or would not be credible as paid media: focal hierarchy is weak, brand or offer is unclear, crop is badly handled, text is difficult to read, disclaimer or CTA is unusable, or the composition appears amateurish and needs substantial redesign. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, or broken outputs are also 0.
